import json
from pathlib import Path
b = Path('/hpc/group/singhlab/user/me196/projects/obsidian/runs/concisejepa_brics_training/20260908-1700-f2r-quantizer-ablation')
c = json.loads((b / 'comparison.json').read_text())
assert c['state'] == 'completed' and c['missing'] == []
print('comparison.state=completed; missing=[]')
def summary(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: summary(v) for k, v in obj.items() if not isinstance(v, list)}
    return obj
for name in ('continuous3', 'fsq5'):
    s = json.loads((b / f'{name}_training_status.json').read_text())
    r = c['runs'][name]
    assert s['state'] == 'completed' and s['exit_code'] == 0
    assert r['epochs'] == 30 and r['final_epoch_metrics']['epoch'] == 29
    print(json.dumps({'condition': name, 'status': s, 'epochs': r['epochs'], 'final_epoch': r['final_epoch_metrics']['epoch'], 'health': summary(r['health']), 'val': summary(r['val']), 'test': summary(r['test'])}, indent=2))

PY
printf '\nGit index inspection:\n'
git rev-parse --show-toplevel && git diff --cached --name-only
